name: Flowera
description:
Flowera is a chatbot studio for building AI assistants that talk to customers on WhatsApp, Instagram and web chat. This connector gives Claude direct access to the AgentFlow builder inside your Flowera workspace.

Describe the assistant you want in plain language and Claude builds it: it adds the nodes, wires the connections, configures the language model, validates the graph and saves it to your workspace as a real, runnable flow. You can then ask Claude to run that flow with a test message and read back exactly what it answered, so you iterate on a conversation design without leaving the chat.

Beyond building, the connector covers the day-to-day work around a live assistant. Claude can list and inspect existing flows, make surgical edits to a single node or connection, declare and trigger webhooks, review recent conversations, and read the leads your assistants have collected.

Everything is scoped to the workspace you choose during sign-in, and permissions are requested separately: reading flows, editing them, running them, reading conversation history and listing credentials are each granted on their own, so you can connect with only what you need. Connected apps can be reviewed and revoked at any time from your Flowera profile.

Requires a Flowera account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flowera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flowera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://portal.flowera.ai/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flowera MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flowera lists 36 MCP tools, including add_node, connect_nodes, create_agentflow, delete_agentflow, delete_flow_state_variable, delete_node, delete_webhook, disconnect_nodes, export_agentflow, generate_agentflow, get_agentflow, and get_connections.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flowera?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flowera in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Flowera requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flowera is developed by Flowera. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
